verdict.rationale: Robots.txt is a fair question for a government web service, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is the probe of efile.sunbiz.org/robots.txt, which is internally inconsistent: it records HTTP 200 but describes a server error, and an earlier check found a page with no robots directives. Nothing shows a real, parseable robots.txt telling an agent what it may read. The dos.fl.gov docs never mention robots.txt.
